No hydration/runtime crashes observed in console logs; only aborted requests tied to navigation/analytics tracking, not render exceptions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mandatory full gate was run as requested. iteration153 suite failed due (a) real sitemap leak and (b) false-positive gone-route SEO assertion. Supplemental test file iteration154_policy_regression confirms matrix 333/18/1 and root/compare/contact noindex+H1 contracts are correct, isolating remaining critical blocker to sitemap filtering and compare flow interactivity.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: run pytest on test_iteration153_local_seo_full_regression.py and test_iteration154_policy_regression.py against local worker http://127.0.0.1:8787. Observed sitemap includes 4 redirect routes and compare submit flow not rendering results under repeated automation. Primary backend RCA: getIndexableRoutes currently filters with `page.schemaTypes` (truthy for empty arrays), so redirect entries with [] schemaTypes leak into sitemap. Mitigation: enforce `classification === 'indexable'` (or `Array.isArray(schemaTypes) && schemaTypes.length > 0`) in indexable route derivation, then rerun both suites.
